shots.note: high establishing crane down at the entrance end: the long pillared hall, sleeping skeletons, the ember glowing on the pedestal mid-hall, the sealed gate far away; 하온 walks in under the camera
low tracking follow from behind-left: 하온 walks down the aisle between the rows of sleeping skeletons toward the distant ember
low side tracking (left to right): she slows, notices a skeleton beside the aisle and turns to it
close two-layer low shot: the sleeping skull in the foreground, 하온 crouching behind it, studying it; slow push
medium-wide pan from the skeleton bay: she rises and walks on toward the pedestal and her teacher (left to right)
front medium-wide at the pedestal: 도원 stands looking down at the ember; 하온 passes in front and comes round to the far side; he lifts his head to her
low insert on the pedestal: the warm ember glowing between the two keepers; 하온 looks down at it
over 하온's shoulder onto 도원: the old keeper looks at his apprentice across the ember
two-shot across the pedestal: 도원 (left) and 하온 (right) face each other, the ember between them; slow push-in; 도원 nods

markers.label: 하온 steps out of the dark entrance into the hall
she notices a skeleton asleep beside the aisle and turns to it
she crouches beside the skull and studies it

도원 hears her and lifts his head from the ember
하온 stops across the pedestal, facing 도원
하온 glances down at the ember
